headline: Wardens Secure Godcrofts While Clashes Shake Contested Northern Basins
war_summary: Warden forces have completed their sweeping maritime push in Godcrofts, securing all nine strategic bases in the sector following five fresh transition events over the past two hours. In Mooring County, total Warden dominance was checked when The Wind Hills slipped into ruined neutrality, leaving eleven bases under Warden control and one vacant. Fighting has violently rekindled in Linn of Mercy, where two rapid base actions centered on Rotdust left one strongpoint abandoned while casualty rolls sharply mounted. Across the snowbound ridges of Weathered Expanse, four base exchanges in two hours preserved a tense deadlock of four bases apiece with one destroyed, as fierce struggles around Frostmarch and Wightwalk drove combined losses past eighteen hundred men. To the east, Stlican Shelf registered renewed turnover near Breaker Town, maintaining a six-to-three Warden edge. Meanwhile, Stonecradle and Callahan's Passage continue to absorb heavy attrition despite static lines over the past two hours, and Fishermans Row has quieted under complete Colonial control.
